ImageDescription.value: Front and top views of the Portuguese Fort of São João Baptista de Ajudá in 1890. Published in La marine au Dahomey : campagne de "La Naiade" (1890–1892) by A. de Salinis in 1901. The book is a contemporary account of a French naval squadron's involvement in the events leading to the Second Franco-Dahomean War of 1892–1894.
